Calculate soil fertility parameters (B = B1 + B2 in DPI).

Source: R/calc_soil_N_available.R
soil_fertility.Rd

Estimates readily available and mineralized nitrogen in the soil as in Fert_Office v1.26 (foglio B). DPI naming: b1 = readily available N from soil total N ("N pronto", DPI B2); b2 = mineralized N from SOM (DPI B1).

Usage

soil_fertility(
  Ntot = 1.2,
  SOM = 2,
  soil.group = "Sandy textures",
  CN = 8,
  ccp = "Autumn-winter crop <150 days",
  soil_seeding = c("traditional", "no-till"),
  crop = NULL,
  coefN_readily = agrinutri_data_get("coefN_readily"),
  coefN_mineralised = agrinutri_data_get("coefN_mineralised"),
  coef_time = agrinutri_data_get("coef_time")
)

Arguments

Ntot

Total nitrogen content in the soil (g/kg, per mille).

SOM

Soil organic matter content (%).

soil.group

Soil group (e.g., "Sandy textures").

CN

Carbon-to-nitrogen ratio.

ccp

Crop category and planting period (e.g., "Autumn-winter crop <150 days").

soil_seeding

Seeding mode, one of "traditional" (default) or "no-till".

crop

Optional crop name; used to check whether the no-till reduction applies to the crop. If NULL, the reduction applies to every crop.

coefN_readily, coefN_mineralised, coef_time

Lookup tables.

Value

A named list containing:

  • b1: Readily available nitrogen (kg/ha), DPI B2 (0 for perennial crops in production).

  • b2: Mineralized nitrogen from SOM (kg/ha), DPI B1.

  • b1_potential: N pronto before the perennial rule (used by the leaching term).

  • no_till_reduction: Reduction for no-till seeding (kg/ha).

  • B: Total soil supply b1 + b2 - no_till_reduction (kg/ha).

  • C_tempo: Time coefficient of the crop phase.

  • units: The units of the output values ("kg/ha").

Details

  • b1 = coef.N.readily x min(Ntot, 2.1); it is counted only for crops with a time coefficient below 1 (cycle shorter than one year). Perennial crops in production (C_tempo = 1) use B = b2 only.

  • b2 = coef.N.mineralised x min(SOM, 3) x C_tempo; the DPI keeps the mineralised N constant above 3 percent organic matter.

  • With soil_seeding = "no-till" (semina su sodo) the soil supply is reduced by 10 kg N/ha, for crops where the DPI allows it (crops.table$no_till_reduction) and only when b1 is counted.

Total B = b1 + b2 - no_till_reduction.

Examples

soil_fertility(Ntot = 1.5, SOM = 2, soil.group = "Loamy textures", CN = 7.7,
               ccp = "Spring-summer crop 100-130 days")
#> $b1
#> [1] 39
#> 
#> $b2
#> [1] 34.84
#> 
#> $b1_potential
#> [1] 39
#> 
#> $no_till_reduction
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $B
#> [1] 73.84
#> 
#> $C_tempo
#> [1] 0.67
#> 
#> $units
#> [1] "kg/ha"
#>
